title: Carmel, IN - Traffic Alert: 96th Street Closed After Crash - NewsBreak

By Country Herald Police Reports ,
20 hours ago Country Herald is Local News, Independent Pulse. Covering breaking local news, sports, lifestyle and events. Carmel, Indiana – A crash closed 96th Street in Carmel in both directions, disrupting traffic Wednesday. According to the Carmel Police Department, 96th Street is shut down from Shelborne Road to Inverness Boulevard due to a traffic accident.
